context: A repeated flag splits values on commas

checklist.name: string_array
checklist.description: Switches the flag to `StringArrayVar` (or `StringArray`), explaining that `StringSlice` splits each value on commas while `StringArray` keeps each repeated value literal.

checklist.name: repeat_still_works
checklist.description: Keeps support for repeating the flag to pass several messages.

checklist.name: test
checklist.description: Adds a test on a fresh command tree that passes a value containing a comma plus a second `--message` and asserts exactly two whole values reach the handler.
